candidate_pool.idea: A woman returns a book through a lit library slot at blue hour while snow gathers outside; one gloved hand slides the book and the other holds a scarf end.
A woman under an open-sided canal ferry shelter spreads a folded paper route map over the ticket ledge while she checks the distant ferry lights.
A woman closes a low outdoor cinema poster-case latch after replacing a rolled poster while fresh snow rests on the stone threshold.
A woman pauses at an observatory terrace ledge, using both gloved hands to unfold a paper star chart after the first snow.
A woman on a covered tram platform ties the loose paper wrap of a carried flower bundle on a waist-high ledge as the tram approaches.

selected_concept.idea: A woman closes a low outdoor cinema poster-case latch after replacing a rolled poster while fresh snow rests on the stone threshold.

reference_observations: Soft oval facial proportions, brown eyes, chin-length dark straight bob, wispy separated bangs; visible appearance guidance only.
